mentions.name: Dabao (wireless 36-key convertible split/unibody keyboard)
mentions.description: An open-source wireless 36-key ergonomic keyboard that can be used as either a unibody or split keyboard. Instead of the usual two microcontrollers and batteries (one per half), it uses a single microcontroller and a GPIO expander bridging the two halves via a magnetic 4-pin connector, plus a reversible PCB to keep overall costs low. Runs ZMK firmware, with PCBs brought up and the case design still in progress; all files are open-source on GitHub.
mentions.problem: Split keyboards are cumbersome to use when moving around at coworking spaces, cafes, or on the couch, where a unibody keyboard is more convenient but has less ideal ergonomics.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm deep in the rabbit hole of ergonomic keyboards and working on the design of a wireless, 36-key keyboard that can be used as a unibody or split.
